instruction: Cinematic medium close-up of a contemporary dance performance in a dark studio. On the far left, the man in the brown shirt (R1) is partially visible in profile with his arm raised. In the center, the man in the brown shirt (R3) is in profile facing right, head lowered, with his right arm extended upward. On the right, the woman in the yellow shirt (R4) stands in profile facing right, looking forward with her arms raised. Other dancers' arms are visible reaching upward in the background. Soft overhead light illuminates the dancers against the dark background.
elements: R1 is partially visible in profile with an arm raised
R3 is in the center in profile facing right, with head lowered and right arm extended upward
R4 stands in profile facing right, looking forward with both arms raised
R3 has a head-lowered, single-arm-up pose while R4 has a forward-looking, both-arms-up pose
the dancers are performing in a dark studio under soft overhead light

questions.q: Is R3 the dancer with head lowered and right arm extended upward, rather than R4 being the one with that head-lowered single-arm-up pose?
questions.element: R3 has the head-lowered single-arm-up dance pose

questions.element: R4 has the forward-looking both-arms-raised pose

questions.element: R1 is partially visible in profile with an arm raised

questions.element: R3 faces right in profile with right arm extended upward
